_comment: Single source of truth for the game's balance. Loaded by Src/Core/Services/BalanceConfig.cs (and validated at startup). Times are in seconds, battery capacity in 'charge-seconds' at 1.0x drain, cash in USD. Multipliers are written as the factor that is applied (e.g. 1.45 = +45%).

spamPopup._comment: Phone spam popups: first one 14-20 s into the night, then every 25-40 s. Dismissing one grants relief dopamine.

deskEvent._comment: One 3:00 AM desk event per night (Wi-Fi lag, shady sponsor or golden wave).

charger._comment: Phone #1's charger (key C or the plug sticker). While plugged in it gains battery, adds outlet load and blocks overclock. The night is longer than a full battery, so charging is how you reach dawn.

tolerance._comment: Niche boredom on phone #1: each finished standard video adds perVideo to its niche (up to maxPenalty) and removes recoveryPerVideo from every other niche. A bored niche pays that much less dopamine.

niches._comment: Applied to the primary phone while it plays a standard video of that niche. videoSeconds overrides phone.videoSeconds.

bill._comment: Charged at the end of every Nth night: (base + perSecondaryPhone*phones + perFan + perDay*day) * growthPerCycle^cycle, minus the GRASS_04 discount.

outlet._comment: Wall outlet load per second; above the safe load the overload meter fills until a blackout. HW_07 raises the safe load.

prestige._comment: Grass points = floor((runDopamine / dopamineUnit)^(1/divisor) + day * perDay). Touching grass before the bill forces it adds voluntaryBonus of that (at least +1).

mythics._comment: Unlocked in catalog order. Each one grants dopamineBonusEach plus its own passive; 'value' is that passive's number.

catalog.title: MYTHIC #1: The 3:33 AM Empty Mall Broadcast
catalog.lore: Recorded on a VHS camcorder inside a closed shopping center in 1997.

catalog.title: MYTHIC #2: Frog Playing Acoustic Guitar in Rain
catalog.lore: A lone amphibian strumming melancholic chords under a streetlamp.

catalog.title: MYTHIC #3: Lost CRT Channel 99 Test Pattern
catalog.lore: An unlisted analog frequency that only appears when eyes are half-closed.

catalog.title: MYTHIC #4: Golden Capybara Hot Spring Stream
catalog.lore: Zero thoughts, steam rising, tangerine balanced on head for 4 hours.

catalog.title: MYTHIC #5: Endless Stairwell Elevator Muzak
catalog.lore: Security camera #14 showing a floor number that doesn't exist.

catalog.title: MYTHIC #6: Rotating Low-Poly Spinning Chip
catalog.lore: Accompanied by a heavily compressed 64kbps funk bassline.

catalog.title: MYTHIC #7: Subway Train Passing Through Clouds
catalog.lore: No passengers aboard; outside the window is pure pink static.

catalog.title: MYTHIC #8: The Final Touch Grass Transmission
catalog.lore: A mysterious HD clip of real sunlight hitting actual green grass.
